_comment: The Style Menu she picks from during world design. Each recipe seeds the concept images and the Marble prompt. Her own shipped worlds are added to this menu automatically at runtime.

styles.name: Candy Kingdom
styles.lighting: bright cheerful afternoon light with soft pastel bounce
styles.materials: glossy hard candy, striped lollipop bark, marzipan stone, sugar-frosted surfaces

styles.name: Enchanted Forest
styles.blurb: Old trees, glowing mushrooms, secret paths.
styles.lighting: dappled golden shafts through a high canopy, glowing motes in the air
styles.materials: mossy bark, damp stone, luminous fungi, tangled roots

styles.name: Underwater Reef
styles.blurb: A coral city under the waves.
styles.lighting: rippling caustics from the surface above, soft blue depth haze
styles.materials: living coral, sea glass, smooth wet rock, drifting kelp

styles.name: Snowy Village
styles.blurb: Cosy cottages and deep soft snow.
styles.lighting: blue twilight with warm window glow and lantern pools
styles.materials: packed snow, timber beams, frosted glass, cobblestone

styles.name: Dino Jungle
styles.blurb: Giant ferns and even bigger footprints.
styles.lighting: hot hazy sunlight filtering through enormous fronds
styles.materials: giant fern leaves, wet mud, cracked volcanic rock, hanging vines

styles.name: Fairy Garden
styles.blurb: Tiny doors and flowers taller than you.
styles.lighting: soft early-morning light with dew sparkle and gentle mist
styles.materials: flower petals, spiderweb lace, acorn caps, smooth pebbles
descriptors: miniature world seen from ant height

styles.name: Outer Space
styles.blurb: A little moon base among the stars.
styles.lighting: hard directional starlight with deep shadows and glowing panel strips
styles.materials: brushed metal panels, moon dust, thick glass domes, cable bundles

styles.name: Rainbow Cloud Castle
styles.blurb: A castle floating on the clouds.
styles.lighting: high bright sunlight above a cloud layer, rainbow refraction
styles.materials: fluffy cloud banks, pearly stone, gold trim, translucent glass

styles.name: Friendly Spooky Town
styles.blurb: Silly ghosts and pumpkin lanterns. Never scary!
styles.lighting: big friendly full moon with warm candle-lit windows
styles.materials: crooked timber, carved pumpkins, cobblestone, drifting mist

styles.name: Desert Oasis
styles.blurb: Golden dunes with a secret pool of water.
styles.lighting: low warm late-afternoon sun with long dune shadows
styles.materials: rippled sand, sun-bleached stone, palm fronds, still clear water
